lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: An array of high-luminance circular nodes arranged in approximately eight visible vertical columns along the lateral flank. Within the mid-section, these nodes exhibit a semi-orthogonal spatial arrangement with 3 to 5 nodes per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are aligned with the circular spots; the spots are positioned as central high-intensity maxima at the intersection points of these vertical bands and the horizontal spaces between carinae.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear ridges run horizontally across the lateral profile. Each ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient, with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and deep shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible silhouette of the dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 6-8 small, high-luminance circular clusters concentrated primarily on the distal half of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-luminance elongated feature, consistent with the morphology of a remora, is visible trailing from the ventral region posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point.
